It was a stellar turnout for the U.K. screening of Lionsgate’s The Hunger Games: Sunrise on the Reaping in London.
Those in attendance included Joseph Zada, Elle Fanning, Mckenna Grace, Whitney Peak, Jesse Plemons, Ralph Fiennes, Glenn Close, Kieran Culkin, Rod Stewart, Francis Lawrence, Laura Marcus, Serafin Mishiev, Nina Jacobson and many more.
RELATED: Jennifer Lawrence On Returning To ‘Hunger Games’ For ‘Sunrise On The Reaping’
The film follows sixteen-year-old Haymitch Abernathy (Joseph Zada) from District 12, beginning on the morning of the reaping for the 50th Annual Hunger Games, also known as the Second Quarter Quell, the biggest Games yet with twice as many tributes.
The Hunger Games: Sunrise on the Reaping opens in theaters on November 20.
